items.title: Turn standing outcome intake into durable unprovisioned schedules
items.description: Maintain intake must persist its mapped request and schedule without pretending a clock or executor is installed. Carry generic repeated outcomes and retain specialist routing.
acceptance: Ordinary scheduled intake creates an idempotent trigger and zero immediate runs.
Missing clock/executor is explicit; no external action or permission expansion.
Generic and specialist scheduled requests preserve all mapped inputs.
items.risk: Scheduling semantics must not silently execute or install a background clock.
items.reason: Ordinary daily request saved one trigger and zero immediate runs, explicitly unprovisioned. Full intake survives firing, today resolves at the occurrence, duplicate definitions are idempotent, and post-exit replay wrote the requested local file. Generic and specialist unit tests passed.

items.title: Bind scheduled firing to an explicit host executor and persistent project state

items.risk: No implicit daemon, approval inheritance, model override, or external publishing.
items.reason: Fresh packaged Codex executor completed after origin exit; corrected-schema review and requested-file replay passed. Same-key duplicate did not relaunch; forced timeout resumed the same occurrence; unsupported hosts and permissions remain explicit. No production clock installed.
